dependence_context.note: Records sharing any identical exported protein are connected; common markers link most vectors, so record counts overstate independent cases.

independent_label_source: UniProtKB/Swiss-Prot reviewed family anchors (identity >= 0.90, anchor coverage >= 0.80); deposited CDS names recorded separately.

terms.ncbi: NCBI states that it places no restrictions on the use or distribution of GenBank data, while noting that submitters may hold rights and NCBI cannot transfer unrestricted rights (https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/home/about/policies/).
